vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Merge vulnerability fixes without waiting for a human. `config:recommended` leaves automerge off and the default vulnerability handling only adjusts labels and scheduling, so security PRs outside the manager-specific rules below sat open indefinitely. Applies to every ecosystem; the packageRules entries stay authoritative for routine, non-security updates.

packageRules.description: Automatically merge GitHub Actions dependency updates after Renovate observes green CI.

jazzy-ros-desktop is built by this repository's own pipeline. Its pin lives in devcontainer-compose-pins.yml at the repository root, outside the `ros` path filter in .github/actions/paths-filter/action.yml (which matches .devcontainer/** and docker/**), so merging a bump cannot retrigger the build that produced the digest and bump itself again. That is what makes automerge safe here.

The dev image is built FROM this one, digest-pinned in docker/ros/desktop/ros-desktop.Dockerfile, so a bump here is what rebuilds jazzy-ros-desktop against a newer upstream base — closing the staleness gap recorded as F7 in docs/agents/specs/agent-devcontainer-migration/. The pin sits inside the `ros` path filter on purpose, so merging the bump runs that build; no loop is possible because this repository does not build agent-desktop. Automerge after green CI: the rebuilt jazzy-ros-desktop image itself is what verifies the new base.

Super-Linter and the pre-commit/local tools it pins (Prettier, clang-format, Ansible Lint, Hadolint, Ruff, ShellCheck, Gitleaks, Actionlint, Zizmor) must stay in sync with the pinned Super-Linter image. Update them manually with the /agentdev:sync-super-linter-tool-versions skill instead.
Prettier's additional_dependencies pin in the mirrors-prettier hook is synced manually alongside the mirror revision; see the rule above.
